commentary_title: Strong demand in the USG attracts Aframax tonnage Westward
commentary_summary: The vessel utilisation in week 2 stood at 90% lower by 1% YoY. | It was a rather positive week for the Aframax market due to firm tonnage demand in the USG as rates rose on TD7, 8 and 9. | Port congestion towards the West especially along the US coasts is likely to see an uptick next week with freight rates staying firm. | Market in the Mediterranean however, will likely be up for another quiet week as tonnage demand has been lower side.
